csv_project_name: DB Svc for Fencing & Concrete Pad - SASMO VSAT Compound
csv_scope_of_work: This document outlines the scope of work for the Design and installation of a 100 x100 x5 slab with WWF at the rear of bldg. 4190. The pad has had fill dirt brought in over the last two years and will require some grading and compacting. The slab is to have a broom finish, minimum 3000 psi concrete with 6x6 WWF. There will be approximately 75 satellite equipment locations that require 2 ties down points per location. Method for tie down- Install a internally threaded anchor inserts, studded eye bolts and dust caps for when not in use. Each piece of equipment requires about a 10 x10 area. The layout will be by owner prior to placement; anchors are installed after slab is poured.

title: Design-Build Services for Fencing and Concrete Pad - SASMO VSAT Compound
short_description: Design-build concrete equipment pad and fencing works at Camp Blanding military facility.
project_scope: Design and installation of a concrete slab at the rear of Building 4190 within the SASMO VSAT compound. The slab is specified as approximately 100 x 100 x 5, with welded wire fabric reinforcement, broom finish, and minimum 3000 psi concrete. Existing fill dirt placed over the last two years requires grading and compaction before slab construction. About 75 satellite equipment locations are planned, each requiring roughly a 10 x 10 area and two tie-down points. Tie-downs are to use internally threaded anchor inserts, studded eye bolts, and dust caps, with anchor installation after the slab is poured. The title also references fencing, but no technical fencing scope is described in the source.
services: Design-build services for site grading and compaction, reinforced concrete slab design and installation, and anchor/tie-down detailing and installation; fencing is referenced in the title but not technically described.
relevance_explanation:
- Small, simple concrete pad with basic site works and anchors only.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building structure.
- Primarily a straightforward construction/design-build package, not advanced structural engineering.
- Military facility project; military barracks/facilities are outside sbp's target focus.
- No sustainability, innovation, or architecturally demanding structural component indicated.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available scope information: approximately 100 x 100 x 5 reinforced concrete slab, grading/compaction of previously filled area, about 75 equipment positions with two tie-down anchors each, and possible fencing works referenced only in the title. A realistic cost estimate is not reliable from the provided information alone.
fee_explanation: No planning fee is stated. The tender is a small design-build package for a simple slab and associated site works; no separate engineering fee information is provided.
